lcc_sn: 以下這些人<WAH0428>是挪亞的後代<WH08435>。挪亞<WH05146>是<WAH01961><WTH8804>個義<WH06662>人<WH0376>：在當時的世代<WAH09002><WH01755>、他純全無疵<WH08549>：挪亞<WH05146>跟<WAH0854>上帝<WH0430>往來<WH01980><WTH8694>。
lcc_original: 以下這些人是挪亞的後代。挪亞是個義人：在當時的世代、他純全無疵：挪亞跟上帝往來。
notes: LCC inverts the first clause relative to UNV/Hebrew (אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת נֹחַ): UNV renders '挪亞的後代<WH08435>記在下面<WAH0428>', while LCC renders '以下這些人<WAH0428>是挪亞的後代<WH08435>'. WAH0428 (וְאֵלֶּה, 'these') attaches to 人 as the head of '以下這些人'; WH08435 (תּוֹלְדֹת) attaches to 後代.
LCC uses 上帝 where UNV uses 神, both mapping to WH0430 (אֱלֹהִים).
LCC uses 往來 ('go back and forth / commune') for UNV's 同行 ('walk together'), both rendering the hithpael of הָלַךְ; WH01980+WTH8694 attached to 往來.
LCC uses 純全無疵 for UNV's 完全 (WH08549, תָּמִים = blameless/perfect); WH08549 attached after 疵 as the terminal word of the phrase.
LCC inserts 他 as an explicit subject ('he was blameless') with no Hebrew equivalent; left untagged.
The 挪亞 in LCC's first clause ('挪亞的後代') corresponds to the unnoted נֹחַ in the construct chain תּוֹלְדֹת נֹחַ, consistent with UNV not tagging that occurrence; WH05146 is not attached there.
